question: On bounce (3rd down close), does 1-year prior return (ret_252) grade the bounce, i.e. do prior-year leaders (higher ret_252) bounce better than laggards? (expect higher=better, 'leader washout' idea)
plain: Leader washout idea: after a 3-day pullback, does a stock that was already a big 1-year winner bounce better than a stock that wasn't?
